import unittest

from solution import catalog_snapshot


class CatalogSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.items = [
            {"id": "b", "title": "Beta", "votes": 5},
            {"id": "a", "title": "Alpha", "votes": 5},
            {"id": "c", "title": "Alpha", "votes": 8},
            {"id": "d", "title": "Alpha", "votes": 5},
        ]
        self.collections = [
            {"id": "z", "name": "Second", "item_ids": ["b"]},
            {"id": "b-col", "name": "First", "item_ids": ["a", "a", "c"]},
            {"id": "a-col", "name": "First", "item_ids": []},
        ]

    def test_sorting_totals_and_independent_pagination(self):
        result = catalog_snapshot(self.items, self.collections, 1, 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["item_total"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(result["collection_total"], 3)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in result["items"]], ["c", "a"])
        self.assertEqual([collection["id"] for collection in result["collections"]],
                         ["a-col", "b-col"])
        resolved = result["collections"][1]["resolved_items"]
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in resolved], ["a", "a", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(result["collections"][1]["item_ids"], ["a", "a", "c"])

        second = catalog_snapshot(self.items, self.collections, 2, 2)
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in second["items"]], ["d", "b"])
        self.assertEqual([collection["id"] for collection in second["collections"]], ["z"])

    def test_deep_copy_and_no_aliasing(self):
        result = catalog_snapshot(self.items, self.collections, 1, 10)
        returned_a = next(item for item in result["items"] if item["id"] == "a")
        collection = next(c for c in result["collections"] if c["id"] == "b-col")
        first_a, second_a = collection["resolved_items"][:2]
        self.assertIsNot(returned_a, self.items[1])
        self.assertIsNot(collection, self.collections[1])
        self.assertIsNot(collection["item_ids"], self.collections[1]["item_ids"])
        self.assertIsNot(first_a, second_a)
        self.assertIsNot(first_a, returned_a)

        self.items[1]["title"] = "Changed input"
        self.collections[1]["item_ids"][0] = "b"
        self.assertEqual(returned_a["title"], "Alpha")
        self.assertEqual(collection["item_ids"], ["a", "a", "c"])
        first_a["title"] = "Changed output"
        self.assertEqual(second_a["title"], "Alpha")
        self.assertEqual(returned_a["title"], "Alpha")

    def test_empty_and_beyond_last_page(self):
        self.assertEqual(catalog_snapshot([], [], 1, 3), {
            "item_total": 0,
            "collection_total": 0,
            "items": [],
            "collections": [],
        })
        result = catalog_snapshot(self.items, self.collections, 99, 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["item_total"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(result["collection_total"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(result["items"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["collections"], [])

    def test_page_validation(self):
        for page, page_size in ((True, 1), (1, False), (0, 1), (1, 0),
                                (-1, 2), (1, -2), (1.0, 2), (1, "2")):
            with self.subTest(page=page, page_size=page_size), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                catalog_snapshot([], [], page, page_size)

    def test_item_validation(self):
        malformed_lists = [
            [{"id": "a", "title": "A"}],
            [{"id": "a", "title": "A", "votes": 1, "extra": 2}],
            [{"id": "", "title": "A", "votes": 1}],
            [{"id": "a", "title": "", "votes": 1}],
            [{"id": "a", "title": "A", "votes": True}],
            [{"id": "a", "title": "A", "votes": 1},
             {"id": "a", "title": "B", "votes": 2}],
        ]
        for items in malformed_lists:
            with self.subTest(items=items), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                catalog_snapshot(items, [], 1, 10)

    def test_collection_validation(self):
        one_item = [{"id": "a", "title": "A", "votes": 1}]
        malformed_lists = [
            [{"id": "c", "name": "C"}],
            [{"id": "c", "name": "C", "item_ids": [], "extra": 1}],
            [{"id": "", "name": "C", "item_ids": []}],
            [{"id": "c", "name": "", "item_ids": []}],
            [{"id": "c", "name": "C", "item_ids": ["missing"]}],
            [{"id": "c", "name": "C", "item_ids": [1]}],
            [{"id": "c", "name": "C", "item_ids": []},
             {"id": "c", "name": "D", "item_ids": []}],
        ]
        for collections in malformed_lists:
            with self.subTest(collections=collections), self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                catalog_snapshot(one_item, collections, 1, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
